![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14069302/assets/9fd222d255fd1a37f00cbe7c9abf6af0d0e3af92f9ac581591bb1062780e69fa.png)

Which of the following is equivalent to the integral ${\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r,$ where $C$ is the closed polygonal path $ABCA,$ shown in the diagram above, traversed in the **clockwise** direction?
worked_solution:
First, notice that we can represent $C,$ which is traversed clockwise, as the union of $3$ paths:

$$
C={-{C}_{1}}\cup {C}_{2}\cup {-{C}_{3}},
$$

where $-{C}_{1}$ and $-{C}_{3}$ are the same paths as ${C}_{1}$ and ${C}_{3}$ but traversed in the opposite direction.

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r & ={\int }_{-{C}_{1}}F\cdot \text{d}r+{\int }_{{C}_{2}}F\cdot \text{d}r+{\int }_{-{C}_{3}}F\cdot \text{d}r \\  & =-{\int }_{{C}_{1}}F\cdot \text{d}r+{\int }_{{C}_{2}}F\cdot \text{d}r-{\int }_{{C}_{3}}F\cdot \text{d}r.\end{aligned}
$$
